- **Flush Under-Track V-Cradles (No Air Gaps)**: Added angled wooden V-cradle arms and outer vertical brass riser posts on every support bent that meet the exact underside of both V-trough boards without poking into the inner channel, eliminating all air gaps beneath the middle and right-side supports.
- **Unobstructed, Clip-Free Target Cup**: Removed the side catch walls around the cup and shortened the lower chute (`p2B = [0.71, 0.095, 0.283]`) so it terminates cleanly outside the white cup rim with zero mesh intersection. The cup is now framed only by a brass base ring, brass rim collar, and a single sleek walnut-and-brass rear backstop supported by twin brass posts.
- **Zero Left-Edge Overhang**: Shifted the upper base plinth and the first vertical support bent inward (`s = 0.20`, directly above the left desk leg) and added diagonal brass cantilever braces supporting the upper launch hopper, so all base plates and pillars sit well inside the desk surface from every camera angle.
- **Cohesive Walnut & Brass Deflector Rails**: Replaced the bulky dark blue slabs at the mid-track turn and cup with low-profile warm walnut panels topped with brass cornice trim.

content.text:
I have refined `scene.js` to address every point raised in the art director's review while preserving `16/16` validation reliability:

- **Flush Under-Track V-Cradles (No Air Gaps)**: Added angled wooden V-cradle arms and outer vertical brass riser posts on every support bent that meet the exact underside of both V-trough boards without poking into the inner channel, eliminating all air gaps beneath the middle and right-side supports.
- **Unobstructed, Clip-Free Target Cup**: Removed the side catch walls around the cup and shortened the lower chute (`p2B = [0.71, 0.095, 0.283]`) so it terminates cleanly outside the white cup rim with zero mesh intersection. The cup is now framed only by a brass base ring, brass rim collar, and a single sleek walnut-and-brass rear backstop supported by twin brass posts.
- **Zero Left-Edge Overhang**: Shifted the upper base plinth and the first vertical support bent inward (`s = 0.20`, directly above the left desk leg) and added diagonal brass cantilever braces supporting the upper launch hopper, so all base plates and pillars sit well inside the desk surface from every camera angle.
- **Cohesive Walnut & Brass Deflector Rails**: Replaced the bulky dark blue slabs at the mid-track turn and cup with low-profile warm walnut panels topped with brass cornice trim.
